notes: This is the "+1 speed" family: the number going up is the game, speed is bought with upgrades and wins buy better characters, so it is Simulation with preset Stat Grinder, and the parkour course is named second rather than allowed to lead. The shape is tier-ladder - five course levels of rising speed requirement, each walled off until the stat crosses the threshold, which is exactly the tiers-in-a-line-with-a-gate-between-them layout, and it keeps the build on P0. I took obstacle-jump from Obby & Platformer for the bright floating-platform parkour the answers describe, but deliberately not path-track, because its P6 would validate physics-legal gaps this game does not need - here the barrier is the speed number, not the geometry. Without a user I kept the preset's rebirth pad at the far end of the last tier even though no rebirth was named, since buying better anime characters is the permanent-multiplier step the family always ends on, and read social-hub as the character shop wins are spent at.
